'''Hiroki''' (Japanese: '''ヒロキ''' ''Hiroki'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|SM}}. He is a student at the [[Pokémon School]] on [[Melemele Island]].

==History==
Hiroki debuted in ''[[SM019|A Guardian Rematch!]]'', where he was seen having a {{pkmn|battle}} against {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Rockruff}}. He was soon defeated.

In ''[[SM042|Alola, Kanto!]]'', Hiroki was seen heading to [[Kanto]] on the same plane as Ash and {{ashcl}}.

Hiroki was one of the {{pkmn|Trainer}}s that had his [[Z-Crystal]] stolen by a {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Pheromosa}}, as revealed in a flashback in ''[[SM114|Beauty is Only Crystal Deep!]]''.

In ''[[SM129|Battle Royal 151!]]'', Hiroki was among the 151 Trainers taking part in the [[Battle Royal]] preliminary round of the [[Manalo Conference]], which he entered with his Mudbray. After challenging the others to take him on, he was swiftly defeated, becoming the first to be knocked out. In the same episode's [[Poké Problem]] segment, he was shown being upset and angry after seeing the Top 16 being announced.

==Character==
Hiroki is an egotistical Trainer. He was overly confident about his chances of winning in ''[[SM129|Battle Royal 151!]]'', calling for the other [[Manalo Conference]] competitors to take him on. However, he suffered a quick defeat, bruising his ego.
